question: The Union Budget 2021 announced the privatization of ______ public sector banks and one general insurance company in the upcoming fiscal year 2021-22.
solution:
The correct answer is __**two**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Union Budget 2021-22**__

 __
 
• Union Minister of Finance and Corporate Affairs **Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman**, Presenting the** first ever digital Union Budget**.
 
 
 
• **Disinvestment and Strategic Sale**__ 
 __
 
• Rs. 1,75,000 crore estimated receipts from disinvestment in **BE 2020-21**.
 
• Strategic disinvestment of **BPCL**, **Air India**, **Shipping Corporation of India**, **Container Corporation of India**,** IDBI Bank**, **BEML**, **Pawan Hans**, **Neelachal Ispat Nigam limited **etc. to be completed in 2021-22.
 
• New policy for Strategic Disinvestment approved; **CPSEs** except in four strategic areas to be privatized.
 
• Other than IDBI Bank,** two Public Sector Banks **and **one General Insurance company** to be privatized.
 
• **Initial Public Offering**(IPO) of LIC in 2021-22.
 
• Incentivizing States for **disinvestment** of their Public Sector Companies, using central funds.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Budget**__

 __
 
• The **first budget** was introduced by the** East India Company** in the year **1860** in India.
 
• It was presented by the Finance Minister of India,** James Wilson**
 
• Budget is also known as the **Annual Financial Statement** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The term used in **Article 112** is '**Annual Finance Statement**'.
 
• **R. K. Shanmukham Chetty** presented the** first Union budget** of **independent India** on **November 26**, **1947**.
 
• **Indira Gandhi **was the only woman Finance Minister who was also the** Prime Minister** while presenting the budget.
 
• The financial year in India is from** 1st April** to **31st March**.
 
• The term** budget** is** not** used in the** Indian constitution**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The highlights from the Union Budget 2022-23:__

 
 
• 5G spectrum auctions to be carried out in calendar 2022 to enable the launch of services within **FY22-23.**
 
• Digital rupee to be issued using blockchain and other technologies and will be issued by RBI starting 2022-23.
 
• 68% of the capital procurement budget for Defence to be earmarked for domestic industry to promote Aatmanirbhar and reduce dependence on imports.
 
• Digital Ecosystem for Skilling and Livelihood (DESH-Stack e-portal) will be launched to empower citizens to skill, reskill or upskill through online training.
